title: L3 back-validation, dual-track redesign (appendix W D2). Pre-registered before any run.
lock_rule: Criteria and kill lines frozen before the tracks ran. Never relaxed afterwards. This is a NEW file; probes/l3_backvalidation_prereg.json is a frozen red line and is not touched by it.
supersedes_nothing: This is not a revision of the v1 pre-registration. The v1 file stays byte-identical. v2 governs a different question, asked because the stage-1 pilot answered the old one.
why_the_redesign: The stage-1 pilot scored EC and PC against a truth of 90.5 and 64.9 and got 23.1 and 17.0, with recall@20 = 0. But EC and PC are out of the model's domain, so the pilot measured the wrong skill. Two separate questions were being asked at once and they need separate instruments: can the model rank the candidates it was actually built for (track A), and does anything stop it from quietly ranking the candidates it was not built for (track B).

locked_values_carried_forward_unchanged.pass_expression: C1 and C2_solvent and C2_additive and C3
locked_values_carried_forward_unchanged.note: not one of these is touched by v2. v2 adds two tracks; it relaxes nothing.

pool.scaling_disclosure_required: the real funnel sees a 29.5k candidate pool. Recall on a 236-compound roster is systematically easier than recall on 29.5k. Every recall reading produced under this pre-registration must carry the pool size in the same sentence.

track_a_in_domain_recall.question: with the candidates it is actually built for held out of the training side, does the model put them back near the top?
track_a_in_domain_recall.roster_rule: from the 236 pool, take compounds whose name matches the glyme/ether family (glyme, dimethoxyethane, dioxane, tetrahydrofuran, methyltetrahydrofuran) or the nitrile family (acetonitrile, propionitrile, butyronitrile, valeronitrile, benzonitrile, succinonitrile, glutaronitrile, adiponitrile), exclude the two champions, and keep those with target epsilon >= 25. The roster is materialised at run time from that rule and its count and sha256 are pinned in the run summary.
track_a_in_domain_recall.holdout: every roster compound is removed from the training side of every fold and scored by the pool-production model, exactly as amendment_3 clause (i)-(iii) does for the champions. No fold's training rows contain a roster compound.
track_a_in_domain_recall.metric: recall@20 over the roster, on the 236-pool ranking
track_a_in_domain_recall.kill_line: recall@20 < 0.25 -> the ranking channel is not usable even in domain, and that is the finding
track_a_in_domain_recall.reference_point: the stage-1 pilot measured 0.00 on the two out-of-domain champions; that number is the reason this track exists, not the bar for it

track_b_out_of_domain_flag.question: when a candidate is out of domain, does anything stop it from being quietly ranked?
track_b_out_of_domain_flag.instrument: the feature-envelope gate, pre-registered separately and already locked
track_b_out_of_domain_flag.routing_rule: a flagged candidate is removed from the ranking channel and routed to measurement or a physical estimate. It may not appear in the top-20 list under any label.
track_b_out_of_domain_flag.pass_criterion: both nominated candidates are flagged, and the flag rate over the in-domain track-A roster is at most 0.20
track_b_out_of_domain_flag.kill_line: a nominated candidate is silently ranked (no flag) -> track B is dead; a flag rate above 0.50 over the in-domain roster is likewise a dead gate, because a gate that rings on everything is worth nothing
track_b_out_of_domain_flag.why_this_is_the_point: in the stage-1 pilot not one existing gate fired on EC or PC. The structural SMARTS rules target associating liquids, and EC and PC carry no O-H. The model was quietly wrong with no flag. That is a worse failure than an error.

interaction_rule: the two tracks are scored independently. Track A does not rescue track B and track B does not excuse track A. A candidate may not be removed from track A's roster because track B flagged it.
reporting_rules: both tracks are reported whether or not they pass
a track whose control is missing is not reported as passed
no reading from this pre-registration may be quoted without the pool size
no reading from this pre-registration is a statement that the L3 funnel works end to end; only the four-channel pass_expression decides that, and it is untouched
forbidden: widening the roster after seeing the recall
tuning the envelope gate's k or percentile after seeing whether EC and PC flag
using a candidate's own target value inside either track
reporting recall without the pool size
quoting a gain against the v1.0 headline 0.364 without its pool definition

shots_policy.rule: attempts at either track are counted in reports/decisions_log.md section 12
